sources.title: K2-BLACKWELL/recipes/k2-horizon-3.7b-gguf at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon-3.7B GGUF on one RTX 5090 (llama.cpp) IFM's BF16 GGUF of the 3.7B on the IFM llama.cpp fork at a 131,072-token context with bf16 KV on one 32 GB card: 140-152 tok/s single-stream decode, prefill 12,366 tok/s at 3.9K, and the 60K-in-100K needle found (100,035-token prompt, 36 s end to end). Single request at a time (--parallel 1): four concurrent streams queued to 151 tok/s aggregate.

sources.title: Claude
sources.snippet: Claude can process large amounts of information, brainstorm ideas, generate text and code, help you understand subjects, coach you through difficult situations, simplify your busywork so you can focus on what matters most, and so much more.

sources.title: K2 Horizon 3.7B - 512K context, open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon-3.7B is a small dense K2 Horizon decoder-only model: 3.7B parameters, 512K native context, and Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face (IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B). Part of IFM's six-model open fleet alongside larger MoE and dense siblings.
